entry.title: Marimba: A System One Model for Speech. [R]
entry.summary: Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18330 Follow-up to last week's post, now with the paper. You ask a typed question about an audio window (yes/no, a choice, or a score) and get a calibrated probability back. One frozen Qwen3-ASR-0.6B encoder pass per 8 s window serves all questions.
